reasoning: 驗證目標：Cabin Output Channel 選定 HU Satellite Audio 來源時，使用者可請求 Tune Down 功能，HU 進入 Tune Down 狀態並前往previous個可用頻道。關鍵情境條件：請求來源（ICS HMI 與方向盤按鍵）。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 是該節的能力總述，獨有內容是**請求路徑**——狀態進入與相鄰頻道調諧由 026 覆蓋、wrap-around 由 027 覆蓋、旋鈕路徑由 028 覆蓋（其信號與抑制條件另有條款），依 §8.2.1 不重複驗證。一條 TC 內以兩個請求路徑涵蓋同一驗證目標，依 §5.7 不拆分。**VR trigger path HELD pending the same chat ruling raised at B3 leaves 006/014 (profile §6, Delta 7): the clause grants the request via HU HMI / ICS HMI, Steering Wheel Buttons **or a VR Command**. AMFM's R8 is explicitly not inherited, so the VR path is neither generated nor declared out of scope; this TC covers the unambiguous paths.** 037 title 相似度 0.716，但差異**不是**省略 VR——title 逐字帶有 `or a VR Command`，截斷處在第一句句末，漏掉的是第二句（進入狀態與前往前一個可用頻道，含 wrap-around）。依 §8.6 以條文為準補回該句。[A-SX10] VR 觸發路徑依裁決排除於本 workbook 範圍之外，委派 CFTS028 （Voice Recognition）交付；本 TC 只驗觸控／實體鍵進入路徑。量測附記：本 leaf 的 037 title 逐字含 `or a VR Command`，與該裁決所載前提（五條 title 均未提及 VR）不符，故其逃生口（title 已宣告 VR 者個別回裁）於本 leaf 成立，待上游確認。

tcs.tc_title: Tune Down is requested from the ICS HMI and the steering wheel
tcs.test_item: When the Cabin Output Channel has selected the HU Satellite Audio source, the user can request a Tune Down to Previous Channel function using the HU ICS HMI or Steering Wheel Buttons. When the user selects the Tune Down function the HU will enter the Tune Down state and go to the previous available Channel
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The tuned channel is not at either end of the channel lineup
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the tuned channel number
2. Request Tune Down from the ICS HMI and read the tuned channel
3. Note the new channel number
4. Request Tune Down from the Steering Wheel Buttons and read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The starting channel is playing
2. The HU enters the Tune Down state and tunes to the previous available channel
3. The channel reached in step 2 is playing
4. The HU tunes to the previous available channel from there
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
